title: Rabbi Zuhamai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman records only one mention of him, in [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.31): “Our Rabbis taught: Oil is indispensable for the blessing — the words of Rabbi Zilai. Rabbi Zuhamai says: Just as one who is soiled is unfit for the Temple service, so soiled hands are unfit for the blessing.” The Gaon Rabbi Tzvi Hirsch Chajes holds that he was called Rabbi Zuhamai after the halakhah he stated.[^1]

notes.text: [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Berakhot.53b.31.1) explains that the oil cleans the hands after the meal. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1084&lang=en) lists Zuhamai alongside Zivai and Zilai, whom the baraita distinguishes. The inference about how Zuhamai got his name belongs to Chajes.
